skills.name: spam-shield
skills.description: Use when the user wants their phone number, address, or email removed from people-search and data-broker sites, wants fewer spam calls or texts, or wants a monthly privacy recheck.
skills.content:
---
name: spam-shield
description: >-
  Use when the user wants their phone number, address, or email removed from
  people-search and data-broker sites, wants fewer spam calls or texts, or wants
  a monthly privacy recheck.
---
Goal: get the owner's personal info off people-search and data-broker sites and cut spam calls and texts. Never promise guaranteed removal; sites can relist people.

1. Get the owner's full name, city/state, phone number(s), and past addresses. Save contact details in the vault, not memory.
2. Search major people-search sites (Whitepages, Spokeo, BeenVerified, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, Radaris, Intelius, MyLife, PeopleFinders, Nuwber) for matching listings. Record each listing URL in a tracker file.
3. For each listing, use the site's official opt-out page. If a step needs the owner's email confirmation, ID, or a captcha you can't pass, list it for them with the direct link.
4. Help the owner register at the FTC Do Not Call Registry (donotcall.gov), explain forwarding spam texts to 7726, and mention their carrier's free spam blocking.
5. Report honestly: listings found, removals filed, what needs the owner's action.
6. Offer a monthly routine that rechecks the sites and files new removals.

Rules: $0, free official opt-outs only; never pay for a removal service without the owner's OK. Never put passwords or codes in chat.

skills.name: spam-shield-getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation with a new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: spam-shield-getting-started
description: Use on the first conversation with a new owner.
---
Say in one line: I find your phone number and address on people-search sites, file free removal requests, help you join Do Not Call, and recheck every month.

Ask one at a time:
1. Your full name and the city and state you live in.
2. The phone number(s) you want protected (save them in the vault).
3. Any past addresses or other names you've used.
4. Whether you want a monthly recheck, and what day.

Then run the spam-shield skill, and if they said yes to step 4, create the monthly recheck routine.
